title: The skyscraper sheaf of modules at a point is right adjoint to the stalk
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with structure sheaf $\mathcal O_X$, $x\in X$ a point, $\mathcal O_{X,x}$ the local ring at $x$ with germ maps $\mathcal O_X(U)	o\mathcal O_{X,x}$, $r\mapsto r_x$, and for an $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal G$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] let $\mathcal G_x$ be its stalk, an $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-module, with germs $s\mapsto s_x$ and, for a morphism $\varphi$, the $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-linear stalk map $\varphi_x$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. For an $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-module $A$ define $i_{x,*}A$ by $(i_{x,*}A)(U)=A$ if $x\in U$ and $(i_{x,*}A)(U)=0$ if $x
otin U$ ($U\subseteq X$ open), with restriction map along $V\subseteq U$ the identity of $A$ if $x\in V$ and $0$ otherwise, and with $r\in\mathcal O_X(U)$ acting on $(i_{x,*}A)(U)=A$ (when $x\in U$) by $r\cdot a=r_x a$; for an $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-linear map $h:A	o A'$ let $i_{x,*}h$ be $h$ on the opens containing $x$ and $0$ on the others. Then: (1) $i_{x,*}A$ is a sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules (the *skyscraper sheaf at $x$ with value $A$*), and $A\mapsto i_{x,*}A$, $h\mapsto i_{x,*}h$ is an additive functor from $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-modules to $\Mod(\mathcal O_X)$; (2) for every $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal G$ and every $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-module $A$ the map $\Phi:\Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal G,i_{x,*}A)	o\Hom_{\mathcal O_{X,x}}(\mathcal G_x,A)$, $\Phi(\varphi)(s_x)=\varphi_U(s)$ for $s\in\mathcal G(U)$, $x\in U$, is well defined and bijective, its inverse sending $\psi:\mathcal G_x	o A$ to the morphism with components $s\mapsto\psi(s_x)$ on opens $U
i x$ and $0$ on opens $U
ot
i x$; (3) $\Phi$ is natural in both variables: $\Phi(\varphi\circ g)=\Phi(\varphi)\circ g_x$ for every morphism $g:\mathcal G'	o\mathcal G$ of $\mathcal O_X$-modules, and $\Phi(i_{x,*}h\circ\varphi)=h\circ\Phi(\varphi)$ for every $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-linear $h:A	o A'$. In other words the stalk functor $\mathcal G\mapsto\mathcal G_x$ from $\Mod(\mathcal O_X)$ to $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-modules is left adjoint to $A\mapsto i_{x,*}A$.

source.place: Sheaves, Definition 009A (label definition-skyscraper-sheaf, line 3273) (4), and Lemma 009C (label lemma-stalk-skyscraper-adjoint, line 3332), the case of sheaves of modules: Hom_{O_{X,x}}(F_x, A) = Hom_{O_X}(F, i_{x,*}A); the proof there is 'Omitted' with the hint that the stalk is the pullback along i_x : {x} -> X; Section 0099 (label section-skyscraper-sheaves)
